record.paper_title: XXX Spin Chain: from Bethe Solution to Open Problems
record.original_question: Consider the XXZ spin chain with Hamiltonian H_XXZ in the gapped antiferromagnetic regime Δ < -1. In this regime the entropy S(ρ(n)) of a block of n neighboring spins in the ground state is expected to converge, as n becomes large, to a finite limiting value S(∞). Determine analytically this limiting subsystem entropy S(∞) for the XXZ spin chain when the block size tends to infinity.

evidence.quote: In the gapped antiferromagnetic case (∆ < −1) we expect that S(ρ(n)) will tend to a limiting value S(∞) but at this moment the analytic evaluation of this constant is missing.
Open problem: For the XXZ spin chain in the antiferromagnetic region (∆ < −1) calculate the limiting value of the entropy of a subsystem when the number of spins in the block is large.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the spin-1/2 XXZ Heisenberg chain on the infinite lattice Z with Hamiltonian
  H_{XXZ} = - sum_{j in Z} ( S^x_j S^x_{j+1} + S^y_j S^y_{j+1} + Δ S^z_j S^z_{j+1} ),
where S^x, S^y, S^z = (1/2) σ^{x,y,z} are spin-1/2 operators, and assume the gapped antiferromagnetic regime Δ < -1. Let |GS> be a ground state of H_{XXZ} (in the thermodynamic limit), and for a contiguous block A_n = {1, 2, ..., n} of n neighboring sites let
  ρ(n) = Tr_{Z \ A_n} |GS><GS|
be the reduced density matrix on A_n. Define the von Neumann subsystem entropy
  S(ρ(n)) = - Tr( ρ(n) log ρ(n) ).
Since the model is gapped, S(ρ(n)) tends to a finite limit S(∞) = lim_{n → ∞} S(ρ(n)).

Determine S(∞) analytically as an explicit function of the anisotropy parameter Δ < -1.
artifact.category_tag: Entanglement entropy in integrable spin chains
artifact.status_search_result: The limiting block entropy of the gapped antiferromagnetic XXZ chain has been computed analytically using the corner transfer matrix method, by relating ρ(n) (in the n → ∞ limit) to the corner transfer matrix of the six/eight-vertex model. The exact expression for S(∞) as a function of Δ < -1 is given in closed form involving the elliptic nome / modular parameter associated with Δ; see Calabrese, Ercolessi, Evangelisti, Ravanini and related work, as well as the corner-transfer-matrix treatment of the XYZ chain whose sine-Gordon / XXZ limit yields the XXZ result.

status_evidence.title: Exact entanglement entropy of the XYZ model and its sine-Gordon limit
status_evidence.snippet: Exact expression for the Von Neumann entropy of the infinite bipartition obtained via the corner transfer matrix of the eight-vertex model; XXZ chain arises as a limit.
status_evidence.claim: The saturation block entropy of the gapped XXZ chain admits an exact analytic expression.

status_evidence.title: Symmetry resolved entanglement in gapped integrable systems: a corner transfer matrix approach (arXiv:1911.09588)
status_evidence.snippet: Corner transfer matrix approach to gapped U(1) systems including the XXZ chain, with exact expressions for charged moments and entropies.
status_evidence.claim: Analytic results for entanglement entropy in the gapped XXZ chain are available via CTM.

status_evidence.title: Universal corrections to the entanglement entropy in gapped quantum spin chains: a numerical study
status_evidence.snippet: In the gapped XXZ regime, corrections to saturation scale as K_0(2mr); the saturation value is determined by the spectrum.
status_evidence.claim: The saturation value S(∞) is finite and analytically accessible for the gapped XXZ chain.
